3661-5006-6798-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Shield Sphere is starting in your graveyard.
3661-5006-6798-8170.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Shield Sphere spell. Then, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Shield Sphere, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat.

1329-1477-3363.easyPrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1477-3363.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing The One Ring, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast The One Ring from your graveyard this turn.
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

1395-5078-7296-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve the Vraska trigger, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

687-2034-8137.description:
Cast Dunland Crebain by paying its mana cost; it enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
When Dunland Crebain enters, it creates a creature token with mutiple counters on it, including a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing two vigilance counters and one additional counter from creatures you control.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Dunland Crebain and one additional creature, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling yourself three cards and returning Dunland Crebain from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
687-2034-8137.notes: This order of operations and the additional {3} starting mana is necessary because you must activate mana abilities like Ashnod's Altar's before paying the counter removal cost.

5254-5256-8122.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
You don't control an Army, or the only Army you do control is the creature with power 4 or greater.
5254-5256-8122.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature with power 4 or greater. If you control an Army, ensure to sacrifice that creature.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
5254-5256-8122.notes: The Orc Army will become a 5/5 due to the counters and the buff provided by The Muckslinger Gang.

1329-2178-3652-4247.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-3652-4247.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3641-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3641-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2034-3490-6283-7818.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
2034-3490-6283-7818.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Liliana the Faultless indestructible.
2034-3490-6283-7818.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

372-1090-7495.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-1090-7495.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Restoration Angel until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast All Aboard by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Restoration Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Restoration Angel's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Restoration Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

3417-6780-7711.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
3417-6780-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger indestructible using Your Temple Is Under Attack.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger.
Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
3417-6780-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

3532-5078-7010-7656.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-7010-7656.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
3532-5078-7010-7656.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Elena triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

813-3617-7431.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk and Daydream from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2829-6871-6879-7223.description:
Cast Stalactite Dagger by paying {2}.
When Stalactite Dagger enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
When the Shapeshifter enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Stalactite Dagger, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Stalactite Dagger.
When Stalactite Dagger dies, Haru triggers, returning Stalactite Dagger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat from step 4.

772-891-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

1477-2906-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 3 life this turn.
1477-2906-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rakdos. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

527-1322-5900.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Selvala.
Repeat.

3028-5702-6753.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
3028-5702-6753.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Nissa, Vital Force
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

57-4846-6657-6965.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4846-6657-6965.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

856-2558-6748-6798.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
856-2558-6748-6798.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, which is a Food due to Ragost, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Sword of the Meek trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Repeat.

864-4050-6977.description:
Cast Emptiness for its evoke cost by paying {W}{W}.
When Emptiness enters, its first ability and evoke ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emptiness, adding {W}.
Resolve Emptiness's evoke trigger, failing to sacrifice it as it's no longer on the battlefield.
Resolve Emptiness's first trigger, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Emptiness from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {W}.
Repeat.

2866-3698-4708-4986.description:
Cast Dark Sphere by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scrap Trawler and Dark Sphere enter, Grinding Station triggers twice, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.

4316-5051-5078-6006.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

4050-4396-5220.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana or less.
4050-4396-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

648-6691.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Activate Garruk's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to draw cards equal to the Fractal's power, thus causing you to draw your entire library.

261-397-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
261-397-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
When the Citizen enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1636-3143-4500-4642.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-4500-4642.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Retreat to Kazandu trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Kazandu trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

215-729-2085-2404.notablePrerequisites:
Kelpie Guide does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five other creatures.
215-729-2085-2404.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least eight {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Great Oak Guardian to your hand.
Cast Great Oak Guardian by paying {5}{G}.
When Great Oak Guardian enters, it triggers itself, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more creatures, this combo will net infinite green mana, which you then may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Kelpie Guide any number of times.

575-3510-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Saproling and/or creature with changeling.
575-3510-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a nontoken Saproling or creature with changeling.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 1/1 Saproling due to Life and Limb.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

2232-2459-3783-4605.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional Illusion creature.
You have a way to cause that Illusion creature to die.
2232-2459-3783-4605.description:
Cause an Illusion you control to die.
Minn triggers, allowing you to put Rograkh from your hand onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio and Preston trigger.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's trigger, declining to return anything.
Resolve Preston's trigger, creating a 0/1 Illusion token copy of Rograkh.
Put the token into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cloudstone Curio and Minn trigger.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's trigger, returning Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve Minn's trigger, putting Rograkh from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-3333-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion etners the battlefield, dealing you and target creature an arbitrarily large amount of damage, with your life total not changing due to Platinum Emperion.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Soldier creature tokens equal to the amount of damage dealt this way.

2034-3263-4494.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
2034-3263-4494.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Reborn Hero, adding {C}{C}.
Reborn Hero dies, causing you to pay {2} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

1261-4644.notablePrerequisites: Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
1261-4644.description:
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untap Time Vault.
Activate Time Vault by tapping it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
